segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and welcome everyone.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，欢迎大家。

segments.en: Today we've got an elementary level lesson for you.
segments.zh: 今天我们为您准备了一节初级水平的课程。

segments.en: It's all about sending things through the mail.
segments.zh: 这期节目讲的是通过邮寄方式寄东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So maybe gifts, maybe letters.

segments.en: We're going to the post office so why don't we jump right into this dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们要去邮局，那我们就直接开始听这段对话吧。

segments.en: Let's listen to it for the first time and we'll be right back.
segments.zh: 我们先听第一遍，马上回来。

segments.zh: 嗨，我想把这个包裹寄到中国和这些明信片。

segments.en: Very well.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: You will need some stamps for the postcards and I need to weigh that package too.
segments.zh: 你需要一些寄明信片的邮票，我还得称一下那个包裹。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: How much is this going to cost?
segments.zh: 这要花多少钱？

segments.en: Well it depends.
segments.zh: 好吧，这取决于。

segments.en: Do you want to send it via priority, express or standard mail?

segments.en: What's the difference?
segments.zh: 有什么区别？

segments.en: Well standard mail can take up to 15 working days.
segments.zh: 标准邮件最多可能需要 15 个工作日。

segments.en: Priority is a bit faster and will arrive in about 5 to 8 working days.
segments.zh: 优先邮件稍快一些，大约五到八个工作日送达。

segments.en: Express is the fastest but it's also the most expensive.
segments.zh: 特快专递最快，但也最贵。

segments.en: It only takes three days and you can track your package online.
segments.zh: 只需三天，您就可以在线跟踪您的包裹。

segments.en: I see.

segments.en: Well there's no rush.

segments.en: Please send it via priority mail.

segments.en: Please be extra careful.

segments.en: The contents of the package are fragile.
segments.zh: 包裹里装的是易碎品。

segments.en: All right so pretty simple dialogue.
segments.zh: 好了，很简单的对话。

segments.en: We want to send a package through the mail.
segments.zh: 我们想通过邮件发送包裹。

segments.en: Alright so the first item we're going to talk about in today's Language Takeaway is something you can send.

segments.en: It's called a postcard.
segments.zh: 它被称为明信片。

segments.en: A postcard.
segments.zh: 一张明信片。

segments.en: Okay so very popular among people who are traveling and they want to send a postcard back home.
segments.zh: 好吧，在旅行的人中非常受欢迎，他们想寄一张明信片回家。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: So a postcard is something that you usually buy at a tourist destination like Walt Disney World for example.
segments.zh: 因此，明信片是您通常在沃尔特迪斯尼世界等旅游目的地购买的东西。

segments.en: And it has a picture on the front and some words on the back.
segments.zh: 它的正面有一张照片，背面有一些文字。

segments.en: So you can write a letter on the back of this picture.
segments.zh: 所以你可以在这张照片的背面写一封信。

segments.en: So it's very simple.

segments.en: It's not really a letter.
segments.zh: 这不是一封真正的信。

segments.en: You don't put it in an envelope.

segments.en: You just write whatever you want on the back of the postcard.

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So stamp is our next word.

segments.en: That means that some stamps are more expensive than other stamps.
segments.zh: 这意味着有些邮票比其他邮票贵。

segments.en: This is like money for the mail.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: True.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: You gotta lick it.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: Okay.

segments.en: To weigh.

segments.en: So now, Catherine, do you usually send postcards when you are abroad, when you travel?
segments.zh: 所以现在，凯瑟琳，你在国外、旅行时通常会寄明信片吗？

segments.en: Yes, I love postcards.
segments.zh: 是的，我喜欢明信片。

segments.en: And actually, I have some friends who have an amazing postcard collection.
segments.zh: 实际上，我有一些朋友有惊人的明信片收藏。

segments.en: Oh, really?
segments.zh: 哦，真的吗？

segments.en: But it's not normal postcards.
segments.zh: 但这不是普通的明信片。

segments.en: They find the most ugly postcards and they buy them and they write silly notes and they send them to themselves.
segments.zh: 他们找到了最丑陋的明信片，然后买了，然后写了愚蠢的笔记，然后把它们寄给自己。

segments.en: Oh, really?
segments.zh: 哦，真的吗？

segments.en: I have the tradition of always sending my parents and my grandparents a postcard when I'm abroad.
segments.zh: 我有在国外时总是给父母和祖父母寄明信片的传统。

segments.en: That's so sweet.
segments.zh: 真贴心。

segments.en: They have a collection of all the places you've been.
segments.zh: 他们收藏了你去过的所有地方的明信片。

segments.en: Yeah, yeah.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: So all the time, wherever I am, the first thing that I try to do if I'm in a cool place, I send them a postcard.
segments.zh: 所以一直以来，无论我在哪里，只要到了个不错的地方，我第一件事就是给他们寄一张明信片。

segments.en: And sometimes if I'm in a country in various cities and there are some nice things in, for example, two or three cities, I'll send them three postcards.
segments.zh: 有时如果去的国家有好几个城市，比如两三个城市都有不错的东西，我就会寄三张明信片。

segments.en: That's awesome.
segments.zh: 太棒了。

segments.en: So do they have a book at home with all of these postcards?
segments.zh: 那么他们家里有一本书，里面有所有这些明信片吗？

segments.en: Yeah, they do.
segments.zh: 对，他们会。

segments.en: So I just send them a little thing, how I'm doing and how great it is and wish you could be here, little notes.
segments.zh: 所以我就是给他们寄点东西，说说我过得怎么样、这里有多好，还有'希望你也在'之类的小留言。

segments.en: And then they have all the collection.
segments.zh: 然后他们拥有所有的收藏。

segments.en: It's really cool because that way I've actually kept track a little bit of what year and what date I was in certain places.
segments.zh: 这真的很酷，因为这样我就能大致记录下自己某年某月去过哪些地方。

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: Well, it's also nice because postcards, you don't need to write a very long note.
segments.zh: 嗯，这也很好，因为明信片，你不需要写很长的便条。

segments.en: There's no space.
segments.zh: 没有空间。

segments.en: You just write a short note.
segments.zh: 你只是写一个简短的笔记。

segments.en: You say, hi, how's the weather?
segments.zh: 你说，嗨，天气怎么样？

segments.en: Miss you.
segments.zh: 想念你。

segments.en: Wish you were here.
segments.zh: 希望你在这里。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's all the time we have for today.
segments.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里。

segments.en: But let us know if you've had any inconveniences at the post office.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您在邮局有任何不便，请告诉我们。

segments.en: I actually had one once.
segments.zh: 我确实遇到过一次。

segments.en: I couldn't send batteries through the mail because they have acid apparently.
segments.zh: 我没法通过邮寄寄电池，因为据说它们含酸。

segments.en: Oh, yeah.
segments.zh: 哦，对。

segments.en: It's very difficult to send.
segments.zh: 发送非常困难。

segments.en: So maybe you've had a situation like this before.
segments.zh: 所以也许你以前有过这样的情况。

segments.en: Let us know, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 请告诉我们，EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye, everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
